title: Add multi-team lookup to Lockbox backend

target.summary: _is_team_specific_accessed_as_global requires team_name to be None, bypassing the guard whenever a team scope is provided. Consequently, if a caller scoped to one team requests an identifier containing another team's namespace, the team-scoped lookup misses and falls through to the global secret lookup in _get_secret_value, exposing the other team's secret.
